english.title: Transferee fail to provide issuing body with notification of transfer / contact details / equine ID within 30 days
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person to whom the ownership of an equine, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..), had been transferred, failed, before the end of the period of 30 days beginning with the day on which the transfer took effect, to

(A)_[notify the issuing body of the transfer of ownership and your name, address and contact details]_
(B)_[send the ID for the equine concerned to the issuing body]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 4(2), 22 and 34 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 monthsNote
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
